content: Jesús, dule-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikad nudaksad
Jesús yar-birgi-sii aideargu, dulemar-bukidar eba duurmakdani gusmalad.
Agi dule-wargwen, naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikad ese sindigar signonikid, ega sognonikid: —Dummad, an wisi, be an-nudakbier, sunna be an-nudaked.
Jesús e-argan oyodgu, e-argangi ebusgu, ega sogded: —Nugubi an be-abe. ¡Be nugusun! Dule-naibe-buna-yaa-maleged-nikad yog nuguar naded.

Geb degi Jesús dulega sogdebalid: —Mer dule-baiganga be-nugusad be sogo. Unnila be nae, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormaladga na be-san oyona. Ar igi Moisés Igar-Mesisa, a-sogedba be ibmar imakna, adi, dulemar nue-be-nugusad mag be-dakegar.
Jesús, Roma-sorda-dummad-e-mai-nudaksad
Jesús Capernaúm-neggweburse dogsagu, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid-wargwen (100) ese nonikid, egi wilenonikid,
ega sognonikid: —Dummadye, an-mai neggi bela abagan-burgwar maid, nue bela-bela nunmaked itomaid.
Geb degi Jesús, abin-sogde: —An daknao. Bega an be-mai nudaknao.
Degi, Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediid (100), Jesús-abin sogded: —Dummad, ¿ande doasunna an-negse be dognaer? Unnila ibmar be sogsa-sae, agi an-mai yog nuguar naoed.

Amba an dummad-nikmogad, degine, ani, an dummadmogad, sordamar ani an sediid. Ar wargwenga an sogdibe, ‘Be nae,’ yog naardaed. Baidga an sogbardibe, ‘Be dage,’ yog dagardaed. Degine, an-maiga an sogdibe, ‘We be imake,’ yog imakardaed. Ar deyobmogad, unnila be sogsa-sae, agi an-mai yog nuguar naoed.

Jesús weyob Roma-sorda-dummad ega soge itoargu, geger-ito naded, geb degi, dulemar-e-sorba-duurmakdanimaladga sogdesun: —Napira an bemarga soged, Israel-dulemargi weyob dule nue an-bensulid an dakdisulid.
”Ar an bega sogdo, bukidar dad-nakwedsik, degine, dad-argwanedsik dule-Judíoʼsurmalad Bab-Dummad-negdakmaidse nonimaloed, adi, Abrahamʼba, Isaacʼba, degine, Jacobʼba mas gunmalagar.
Ar dulemar Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidse-dogmaloenadi, dogosurmalad, negsichidgi magaba melledmaloed. Agi bosii gumaloed, nunmakedba nugar-ogorsii gumaloed.”
Geb degi Jesús Roma-dule-sorda-dulatar-sediidga sogded: “Be nae, ar be bengussursoggu, be-mai an bega nudaksasun.” A-wachigi dummad-e-mai-uellemaid yog nuguar naded.
Jesús, Simón-Pedro-e-sakbundor-uellemaid-nudaksad
Jesús Pedro-negse nonigu, daknonikid, Pedro-e-sakbundor nue uellemai.
Jesús Pedro-sakbundor-e-argangi-ebusgu, uelleged yog surguar naded. Degi, Pedro-e-sakbundor yog gwisguar imaksad, geb a-sorba, Jesúsʼga yog ibmar-imakar naded.
A-ibagi, neg-sedosgu, dulemar bukidar ese niaburba-nikmalad senonimalad. Jesús unnila e-sunmakedgi niaburbamar-onosad, degi, bela dulemar-uellemalad nudaksabalid.
We-ibmar-gusadi, ar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías epenne sogsagusadba guegalad. Deun sogsagusgu:
Isaías 53:4
Jesúsʼba nabigusmalanad
Jesús dulemar-bukidar e-dikarba-gudii daksoggu, e-sapinganga igar uksad, adi, mata-dummad-obakar namalagar.
Degine, geb garda-narmaked-dule-wargwen Jesúsʼse nonikid, ega sognonikid: —Odurdaked-saila, ar bia be naoe, an beba naiguodo.
Jesús abin-sogded: —Ar usmardi na e-gubya nikamalad, sikwimardi e-uu nikamarmogad. Ar andi, Dule-Machi, neg sated. Anyob be unni nanamogale, anba be dagodo.
E-sapin-baid Jesúsʼga sogdemogad: —Dummad, bina an-babse an nagwelo, an-bab-burgwedse geb beba an naoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —An-sapinga-guega anba be dage. Ar dule-baigan, e-dule-burgwarmalad digoed.
Jesús burwa-dummad obogilesad
Agine, Jesús urgi nakwis imaksad. E-sapingan eba nadmarmosunnad.
Mata-abargusgu, burwa-dummad egi noalid. Ar demar bipisursoggu, bela ur demarba doged gualid. Jesúsʼdi uryagi ise-gabar maid.
Geb degi, e-sapingan Jesús-gabmaidse nadmalad, odaksamalad, ega binnasur sogdemalad: —¡Dummad! Anmar-ur dogmai, be anmar-bendake. Anmar bergumaloed.

Jesús abin-sogded: —¿Ar ibi be dobmala? ¿Ar be an-benmarsi? Bemar dobguewilubsulinad. Degine, geb Jesús gwisgusgua, burwaga, degi, demarga sabsur sogded: “Be bogidik gumar.” Geb degi, bela neg bogidik nadsunnad.
Bela e-sapingan geger dakdemalad: —¿Ar we-dulede doasunna, burwase-bakale, demarse-bakale, eba ibsaed?
Jesús Gadara-dorgan-warbogwadgi niamar-onosad

Jesús, degi, e-sapingan, mata-dummad obaksamargu, Gadara-yalase modapmalad. Napase aidesmargu, walabo dule-niasamalad ese nonimalad, neg-uangi gudii noarmalad. Ar we-ebogwad gadi urwemarsoggu, dulemar geg a-igarba nanamalad.

Niasamalad-warbogwad binnasur gotemalad, sogdemalad: —Jesús Bab-Dummad-Machi, ¿ibiga be anmargi yoledaniki? ¿Ar be anmarse danikidi, amba yoo anmar-odurdaked-ibagan-moed-iduar bato be sabsur anmar-odurdakega daniki?
Emar-gunaidgi undar-banguedgi deun sinmar bukidar mas-mananaid.
Niamar Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Ar dulegi be anmar-onogele, weba-sinmar-bukidar-mas-mananaidse be anmar-barmide.

Jesús ega sogded: —Eye, sinmarse be dognamar. Niamar dulegi nodgu, sinmarse nadmarsunnad, agi ubodapmalad. Bela sinmar-ichesulid, danagwen yar-weregedgi babatidmalad. Demarse sinmar bela batismargu, bela gundilegar burgwismalad.
Sin-edarbemalad dobguar duurmakdemalad. Neggweburse modapmargu, bela sogdapmalad, igi sinmar gundilegar burgwismala, degine, igi warbo niasamalad nugusmarbali.
Degi-itosmargua, bela a-neggweburginmalad Jesús-abin ainiarmalad. Jesús-daksamargu, egi wilenaigusmalad, adi, e-yargi naegar. Agi Jesús urgi nakwissunnad.
